## BigDecimal

Operands of *digits* decimal digits at working *precision*, so that
precision grows with the operands. libmpdec is the C library behind
CPython's `decimal`, timed without the interpreter. `round` drops the
low half of the operand; `parse` builds the value from its string.

> **Cross-check failed.** decimo and libmpdec produced different
> products from the same operands. Do not trust this table.

| Digits / precision | Operation | decimo | libmpdec | | CPython `decimal` | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## sqrt, exp, ln, power

A fixed set, chosen before the results were seen. `2.3456789`, and
`** 1.5` for power. 100 000 digits is left out because `mpd_exp`
needs 82 seconds there and `mpd_ln` 239 seconds.

| Precision | Operation | decimo | libmpdec | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 28 | sqrt | 2.47 µs | 844.4 ns | 2.93× slower |
| 28 | exp | 3.92 µs | 4.31 µs | **1.10× faster** |
| 28 | ln | 4.26 µs | 12.28 µs | **2.88× faster** |
| 28 | power | 10.49 µs | 34.01 µs | **3.24× faster** |

| 100 | exp | 9.79 µs | 14.34 µs | **1.46× faster** |
| 100 | ln | 65.62 µs | 37.48 µs | 1.75× slower |
| 100 | power | 85.78 µs | 77.67 µs | 1.10× slower |
| 1,000 | sqrt | 51.82 µs | 214.37 µs | **4.14× faster** |
| 1,000 | exp | 382.45 µs | 4.47 ms | **11.68× faster** |
| 1,000 | ln | 2.81 ms | 5.55 ms | **1.97× faster** |
| 1,000 | power | 3.23 ms | 11.19 ms | **3.47× faster** |
| 10,000 | sqrt | 1.15 ms | 22.62 ms | **19.76× faster** |

| 10,000 | ln | 255.28 ms | 3.133 s | **12.27× faster** |
| 10,000 | power | 306.44 ms | 4.518 s | **14.74× faster** |

## BigInt against CPython's int

CPython's integers can only be reached through the interpreter, so
these include its overhead — read the large sizes as the real ones.
Division is 2n-by-n; two operands of the same width would give a
one-digit quotient and measure nothing.

| Digits | Operation | decimo | CPython `int` | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | add | 35.0 ns | 24.7 ns | 1.42× slower |
| 100 | multiply | 76.7 ns | 105.1 ns | **1.37× faster** |
| 100 | floor divide | 435.0 ns | 291.9 ns | 1.49× slower |
| 100 | sqrt | 462.5 ns | 323.1 ns | 1.43× slower |
| 1,000 | add | 49.4 ns | 83.5 ns | **1.69× faster** |
| 1,000 | multiply | 1.11 µs | 5.29 µs | **4.77× faster** |
| 1,000 | floor divide | 8.70 µs | 12.32 µs | **1.42× faster** |
| 1,000 | sqrt | 3.92 µs | 4.34 µs | **1.11× faster** |
| 10,000 | add | 270.0 ns | 778.8 ns | **2.88× faster** |
| 10,000 | multiply | 52.54 µs | 257.17 µs | **4.89× faster** |
| 10,000 | floor divide | 173.15 µs | 534.08 µs | **3.08× faster** |
| 10,000 | sqrt | 106.13 µs | 259.60 µs | **2.45× faster** |
| 100,000 | add | 2.40 µs | 7.65 µs | **3.19× faster** |
| 100,000 | multiply | 1.15 ms | 8.56 ms | **7.44× faster** |
| 100,000 | floor divide | 4.69 ms | 17.66 ms | **3.77× faster** |
| 100,000 | sqrt | 2.70 ms | 8.15 ms | **3.03× faster** |
| 1,000,000 | add | 26.50 µs | 76.27 µs | **2.88× faster** |
| 1,000,000 | multiply | 23.88 ms | 361.93 ms | **15.16× faster** |
| 1,000,000 | floor divide | 117.33 ms | 729.29 ms | **6.22× faster** |
| 1,000,000 | sqrt | 69.91 ms | 333.28 ms | **4.77× faster** |

## pi()

Each measurement in a fresh process, since mpmath and MPFR cache the
constant. Includes conversion to a decimal string, for every library.

| Digits | decimo | mpmath + GMP | MPFR | mpmath (pure Python) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | 8.06 µs | 49.04 µs | 41.83 µs | 28.67 µs |
| 1,000 | 63.99 µs | 102.75 µs | 63.96 µs | 155.46 µs |
| 10,000 | 1.26 ms | 870.29 µs | 669.88 µs | 5.67 ms |
| 100,000 | 34.27 ms | 15.15 ms | 22.50 ms | 180.75 ms |
| 1,000,000 | 816.87 ms | 261.77 ms | 409.38 ms | 8.337 s |
